title: One clear night plan
summary: Unifies everyday theatre, Pager and break workflows around the selected night.
changes: Shows theatre and Pager assignments directly beneath your personal night, with linked duty times and break groups.
Adds direct Actions for role swaps and breaks, and opens absence and overtime forms immediately.
Uses People, Roles and Review for exceptional changes, while unchanged normal nights need no confirmation.
Keeps the four-nurse exception and clock-change calculations separate from the normal workflow.
